clinical.citation: De novo variants in genes regulating stress granule assembly associate with neurodevelopmental disorders (PMID: 35977029)

variants.description: De novo variants in G3BP1 (specific variants not given in the abstract), reported as a nominally significant excess among 40,853 individuals with NDDs

clinical.diagnostic_reason: Nominally significant excess of de novo variants in G3BP1 in a large NDD cohort. G3BP1 is an essential gene in the core stress granule interaction network. NDD-related de novo variants were shown to disrupt the core SG network interaction and SG formation, though this was tested for the newly implicated and known NDD genes in general.

clinical.citation: G3BP1 Succinylation at K413 is Critical for Cardiac Function by Modulating PI3K-AKT-mTOR Signal Axis (PMID: 42107065)

variants.description: De novo G3BP1 p.E411G (described as disrupting succinylation at K413)

clinical.diagnostic_reason: De novo variant in a DCM patient. The variant disrupts succinylation at K413, and the mechanism of excess PI3K-AKT-mTOR activation was supported by functional data in mouse models and in vitro.

model_organism.citation: Prentzell et al. 2021 - G3BPs tether the TSC complex to lysosomes and suppress mTORC1 signaling (PMID: 33497611)
phenotypes: g3bp1 inhibition disturbed neuronal development and function

model_organism.citation: Liu et al. 2018 - G3BP1 promotes DNA binding and activation of cGAS (PMID: 30510222)
phenotypes: G3BP1 deficiency (cells) led to inefficient cGAS DNA binding and reduced cGAS-dependent IFN production
G3BP1 inhibitor EGCG blocked DNA-induced IFN production in vivo
EGCG blunted autoinflammatory responses in an Aicardi-Goutières syndrome mouse model (pharmacological inhibition, not a genetic knockout in the animal)

model_organism.citation: 2025 - Dysregulation of GTPase-activating protein-binding protein1 in the pathogenesis of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (PMID: 40813380)
phenotypes: Hepatocyte-specific G3BP1 knockout male mice had more severe MASLD and MASH
dysregulated autophagy with impaired autophagosome-lysosome fusion (via STX17 and VAMP8 interactions)

biological.citation: Zhang et al. 2023 - Stress granule homeostasis is modulated by TRIM21-mediated ubiquitination of G3BP1 and autophagy-dependent elimination of stress granules (PMID: 36692217)
biological.summary: TRIM21 catalyzes K63-linked ubiquitination of G3BP1, which inhibits G3BP1 LLPS in vitro, and TRIM21 knockdown promotes SG formation. The autophagy receptors SQSTM1/p62 and CALCOCO2/NDP52 directly interact with G3BP1 during arsenite stress and mediate SG elimination.

biological.citation: G3BP1 promotes DNA binding and activation of cGAS (PMID: 30510222)
biological.summary: G3BP1 physically interacts with cGAS and promotes formation of large cGAS-DNA complexes, enhancing DNA binding and IFN production. G3BP1 deficiency impairs cGAS activation. The G3BP1 inhibitor EGCG disrupts G3BP1-cGAS complexes and blunts autoinflammation in an Aicardi-Goutières syndrome mouse model and in patient cells.

biological.citation: Structure-Mediated RNA Decay by UPF1 and G3BP1 (PMID: 32017897)
biological.summary: G3BP1, together with UPF1, is required for a genome-wide decay pathway targeting mRNAs with highly structured 3' UTRs. Depleting G3BP1 increased steady-state levels of structured mRNAs and circular RNAs.

biological.citation: Identification of small molecule inhibitors of G3BP-driven stress granule formation (PMID: 38284934)
biological.summary: Small molecules G3Ia and G3Ib bind a pocket in G3BP1/2 that is also targeted by viral inhibitors. They disrupt RNA-G3BP1-caprin 1 co-condensation in vitro, inhibit SG formation in cells, and dissolve pre-existing SGs across cell types and stressors.

biological.citation: TRIM25 predominately associates with anti-viral stress granules (PMID: 38750080)
biological.summary: TRIM25 co-condenses with the SG core protein G3BP1 in a dsRNA-dependent manner. This enhances TRIM25 ubiquitination activity toward antiviral proteins and activates RIG-I signaling, restraining RNA virus infection.

biological.citation: DCAF7 Acts as A Scaffold to Recruit USP10 for G3BP1 Deubiquitylation and Facilitates Chemoresistance and Metastasis in Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma (PMID: 38973296)
biological.summary: DCAF7 scaffolds USP10 and G3BP1, removing K48-linked ubiquitin from G3BP1 Lys76. This stabilizes G3BP1 and promotes SG-like structures in NPC cells. G3BP1 knockdown reversed the SG-like structures and the oncogenic effects of DCAF7.

biological.citation: G3BPs tether the TSC complex to lysosomes and suppress mTORC1 signaling (PMID: 33497611)
biological.summary: G3BP1 and G3BP2 localize to the cytoplasmic surface of lysosomes and anchor the TSC complex there, suppressing mTORC1 activation by amino acids and insulin. G3BP1 deficiency causes mTORC1 hyperactivity phenotypes, and low G3BP1 enhances breast cancer cell motility and correlates with poor patient outcomes. g3bp1 inhibition in zebrafish disturbs neuronal development and function.

biological.citation: Stress granules are shock absorbers that prevent excessive innate immune responses to dsRNA (PMID: 37028415)
biological.summary: Without the SG nucleators G3BP1/2 and UBAP2L, dsRNA triggers excessive RLR-mediated inflammation and immune-mediated apoptosis. This also applies to ADAR1-deficiency-derived host dsRNA, and SGs additionally suppress viral replication independently of RLR signaling.

biological.citation: hnRNPA2B1 represses the disassembly of arsenite-induced stress granules and is essential for male fertility (PMID: 38363675)
biological.summary: hnRNPA2B1 interacts with G3BP1, G3BP2, USP10 and Caprin-1. USP10 deubiquitinates G3BP1, and hnRNPA2B1 depletion weakens the G3BP1-USP10/Caprin-1 interaction and raises G3BP1 ubiquitination under arsenite, accelerating SG disassembly.

biological.citation: G3BP1 modulates SPOP to promote prostate tumorigenesis (PMID: 35252555)
biological.summary: G3BP1 interacts with SPOP, the substrate adaptor of the CUL3-SPOP ubiquitin ligase, and acts as an upstream inhibitor of CUL3-SPOP ligase activity. This promotes prostate cancer.
